title: Boundary turn after copying
statement: Let $S$ and $V$ be finite deterministic Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a finite Boolean word, and let $b$ be a choice bit. Starting in the reverse host’s loader state $0$, with its input head at the right boundary blank (position $|x|+1$) and the assembly buffer containing $x$ with its head at position $|x|$, one host step under $b$ yields the loader state $1$, with the input head at position $|x|$, the same assembly buffer and head position, and all other tapes blank and the output empty.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite deterministic Turing machine over Booleans
$V$ is a finite deterministic Turing machine over Booleans
replaced: Let $S, V$ be deterministic machines and $x$ an input. For any choice bit, one host step from the copy-state loader configuration at the right input blank with assembly buffer $x$ yields the rewind-state configuration with the input head moved left to position $|x|$.
